intro: Boughs in the Wind is a traditional rite of passage where an apprentice gathers a wind-infused branch near Falaath Village to fashion a spell focus. Guided by Belann Windwood in Valanaar, the practice honors an ancient custom at a time when magical talent in Zephras is steadily dwindling.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is a time-honored tradition for young adventurers to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Every year that passes in Zephras sees fewer and fewer of those who are gifted with a talent for magic.
I am glad to see young adventurers such as yourself participate in our oldest traditions to help keep our history and culture alive and well.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I can indeed feel the elemental energies in this bough waiting to be harnessed by those that have the gift to do so. This will make an excellent spell focus.
Did this branch sing to you, perhaps? It has often been the case that the branch picks the adventurer, and not the other way around.
